summary: Highway Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K attaching two press releases announcing a US$0.05 per share cash dividend, with an updated record date of August 10, 2026 (revised from August 8) and a payment date of September 22, 2026. CEO Roland Kohl emphasized the company's strengthened financial position and confidence in future value creation. The dividend is a routine capital return to shareholders, not part of a larger special-situation transaction. Monitoring the dividend payment and any subsequent capital allocation decisions would be prudent.
